Gir.name: Gir
Gir.native_region: Gir hills & Kathiawar region, Gujarat, India
Gir.heat_tolerance: High — Excellent adaptability to hot & humid climates
Gir.physical_traits: Reddish/white patched coat, distinctive half-moon curved horns, convex prominent forehead, long pendulous ears.
Gir.disease_resistance: High resistance to tropical diseases and ticks
Gir.special_characteristics: Renowned for A2 beta-casein milk production, high butterfat content (4.5–5%), and global export popularity.

Sahiwal.name: Sahiwal
Sahiwal.heat_tolerance: High — Superior heat and drought endurance
Sahiwal.physical_traits: Reddish brown to pale red coat, loose skin (dewlap), medium horns, massive hump in males.
Sahiwal.special_characteristics: Highest milk producer among indigenous Indian zebu breeds; calm temperament and rich milk.

Holstein_Friesian.name: Holstein Friesian
Holstein_Friesian.native_region: Netherlands / North Germany (Widely crossbred in India)
Holstein_Friesian.heat_tolerance: Moderate to Low — Requires shade & cooling management
Holstein_Friesian.physical_traits: Distinct black and white piebald patterned coat, large body frame, well-developed large udder.
Holstein_Friesian.disease_resistance: Moderate; susceptible to heat stress without management
Holstein_Friesian.special_characteristics: Highest volume milk producer in the world; dominant in modern commercial dairy farms.

Kankrej.name: Kankrej
Kankrej.native_region: Rann of Kutch & Banaskantha, Gujarat & Rajasthan
Kankrej.heat_tolerance: High — Well adapted to arid and semi-arid regions
Kankrej.physical_traits: Silver-grey to dark iron grey coat, unique lyre-shaped large horns, majestic 'Sawai Chal' gait.
Kankrej.disease_resistance: High resistance to heat and infectious diseases
Kankrej.special_characteristics: Famous for its peculiar power-walking gait ('Sawai Chal'); foundation breed for Guzerat cattle.

Ongole.name: Ongole
Ongole.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Excellent tropical heat tolerance
Ongole.physical_traits: Glossy white to grey coat, dark skin around eyes and muzzle, massive muscular hump, sturdily built.
Ongole.disease_resistance: Strong immunity against mad cow disease and tropical ailments
Ongole.special_characteristics: Exported globally (became Brahman breed in Americas); exceptional heavy draft capacity.

Hallikar.name: Hallikar
Hallikar.heat_tolerance: Very High — Highly resilient in dry hilly terrains
Hallikar.physical_traits: Grey to dark grey coat, long backwards curving horns with sharp tips, compact muscular body frame.
Hallikar.special_characteristics: Origin breed for the famous Amritmahal draught strain; prized for agricultural ploughing.

Tharparkar.name: Tharparkar
Tharparkar.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Thrives under desert heat and sparse feed
Tharparkar.physical_traits: White or light grey coat changing shade with season, medium build, lyre-shaped horns.
Tharparkar.disease_resistance: Outstanding drought and disease survival capacity
Tharparkar.special_characteristics: Known as 'White Sindhi'; maintains milk yield even on coarse desert foliage.

Murrah.name: Murrah
Murrah.heat_tolerance: High — Benefits from daily wallowing/water cooling
Murrah.physical_traits: Jet black body, tightly curled spiral horns, short neck, broad hip structure.
Murrah.disease_resistance: High disease resistance and long productive life
Murrah.special_characteristics: The 'Black Gold' of Indian dairy; highest fat content milk (7–8% fat).

Jersey.name: Jersey
Jersey.native_region: Jersey Island (UK) / Crossbred widely in India
Jersey.heat_tolerance: Moderate — Better heat tolerance than Holstein
Jersey.physical_traits: Light fawn to dark reddish-brown coat, dished facial profile, dark muzzle and switch.
Jersey.special_characteristics: Produces milk rich in fat (5–5.5%) and protein; popular for smallholder crossbreeding.

Red_Sindhi.name: Red Sindhi
Red_Sindhi.native_region: Sindh province (Now widely conserved across India)
Red_Sindhi.physical_traits: Deep rich red coat colour, thick skin, heavy hump in bullocks, medium size.
Red_Sindhi.disease_resistance: High resistance to tropical tick-borne diseases
Red_Sindhi.special_characteristics: Valued for crossbreeding programs to improve heat tolerance and dairy yield.

Deoni.name: Deoni
Deoni.heat_tolerance: High — Well suited to Deccan plateau climate
Deoni.physical_traits: White coat with black patches (Wannera / Balankya), drooping ears, convex forehead.
Deoni.special_characteristics: Closely related to Gir cattle; popular in Marathwada for dual-purpose utility.

Khillari.name: Khillari
Khillari.heat_tolerance: Very High — Fast moving and drought tolerant
Khillari.physical_traits: Greyish white coat, long backward sweeping pointed horns, compact athletic frame.
Khillari.special_characteristics: Prized for fast agricultural work and cart transportation across Western Maharashtra.

Alambadi.name: Alambadi
Alambadi.heat_tolerance: High — Suited to hilly forest terrains
Alambadi.physical_traits: Greyish white coat with dark grey neck/quarters, sharp pointed backwards horns.
Alambadi.disease_resistance: High resilience in forest grazing environments
Alambadi.special_characteristics: Traditional hill draught breed closely resembling Hallikar.

Amritmahal.name: Amritmahal
Amritmahal.heat_tolerance: Very High — High stamina for long distance work
Amritmahal.physical_traits: Grey to almost black coat, sharp long horns curving backwards and touching near tips.
Amritmahal.special_characteristics: Historically bred by Tipu Sultan and Wodeyar kings for military transport.

Ayrshire.name: Ayrshire
Ayrshire.physical_traits: Reddish-brown and white coat, medium frame, well-attached symmetrical udder.
Ayrshire.special_characteristics: Known for efficient forage conversion and ideal milk fat-protein ratio for cheese.

Banni.name: Banni
Banni.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Adapted to nocturnal grazing in salt desert
Banni.physical_traits: Black coat, copperish sheen, medium inverted spiral horns, robust body structure.
Banni.disease_resistance: Highly resistant to harsh saline environments and water scarcity
Banni.special_characteristics: Trained for night grazing without herdsmen in the hot Banni grasslands.

Bargur.name: Bargur
Bargur.native_region: Bargur hills, Erode district, Tamil Nadu
Bargur.physical_traits: Brown coat with prominent white specks/patches, light compact build, sharp horns.
Bargur.disease_resistance: Adapted to rugged forest and hill ecosystems
Bargur.special_characteristics: Renowned for fiery speed and trotting endurance in hilly terrain.

Bhadawari.name: Bhadawari
Bhadawari.heat_tolerance: High — Adapted to ravines and hot river valleys
Bhadawari.physical_traits: Copper to light brown coat colour ('Reuta'), wedge-shaped body, ring-like horns.
Bhadawari.special_characteristics: Highest fat percentage in buffalo milk (up to 8.5–13% fat).

Brown_Swiss.name: Brown Swiss
Brown_Swiss.physical_traits: Solid brown or dark greyish-brown coat, large dark eyes with light border, broad muzzle.
Brown_Swiss.special_characteristics: Second highest milk producing dairy breed worldwide with high protein for cheese.

Dangi.name: Dangi
Dangi.heat_tolerance: High — Heavy rainfall and slippery terrain tolerant
Dangi.physical_traits: Red and white or black and white coat spots, thick oily skin secretion.
Dangi.disease_resistance: Tolerant to heavy downpours and foot rot
Dangi.special_characteristics: Secretes oily substance protecting coat against heavy monsoons.

Hariana.name: Hariana
Hariana.heat_tolerance: High — Great stamina in hot summers
Hariana.physical_traits: White or light grey coat, black tail switch, dark face muzzle and horns.
Hariana.special_characteristics: Widely used across North India for agricultural work and family milk supply.

Jaffrabadi.name: Jaffrabadi
Jaffrabadi.physical_traits: Massive black body frame, heavy drooping horns curving down and upwards.
Jaffrabadi.disease_resistance: Robust build and high disease endurance
Jaffrabadi.special_characteristics: Heaviest buffalo breed of India; known for massive butterfat yield.

Kangayam.name: Kangayam
Kangayam.native_region: Tirupur, Karur, Erode & Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
Kangayam.heat_tolerance: Very High — Adapted to semi-arid red soil regions
Kangayam.physical_traits: Grey or white coat with dark markings on hump/head, strong curved horns.
Kangayam.special_characteristics: Iconic draught breed famous for traditional Jallikattu events and farm ploughing.

Kasargod.name: Kasargod
Kasargod.heat_tolerance: High — Adapted to tropical humid climate
Kasargod.physical_traits: Dwarf stature, dark brown to black coat, compact body, small horns.
Kasargod.special_characteristics: Zero-maintenance dwarf breed valued for high quality organic manure and mineral-rich milk.

Kenkatha.name: Kenkatha
Kenkatha.physical_traits: Greyish white to dark grey coat, small pointed horns curving forward.
Kenkatha.special_characteristics: Adapted to rugged hilly terrain and rocky Bundelkhand topography.

Kherigarh.name: Kherigarh
Kherigarh.physical_traits: White coat, thin skin, long thin horns curving up and inward.
Kherigarh.special_characteristics: Active walking speed for ploughing wet paddy fields.

Krishna_Valley.name: Krishna Valley
Krishna_Valley.physical_traits: Greyish white coat, massive muscular frame, short thick horns.
Krishna_Valley.disease_resistance: Strong bone density and muscle power
Krishna_Valley.special_characteristics: Bred for ploughing black cotton soils along Krishna river basin.

Malnad_gidda.name: Malnad Gidda
Malnad_gidda.native_region: Malnad hilly region, Western Ghats, Karnataka
Malnad_gidda.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Adapted to heavy rainfall Ghats
Malnad_gidda.physical_traits: Small miniature frame, black/brown/red coat, small horns.
Malnad_gidda.disease_resistance: High disease resistance, zero maintenance requirement
Malnad_gidda.special_characteristics: Medicinal qualities attributed to milk due to forest herb grazing.

Mehsana.name: Mehsana
Mehsana.physical_traits: Black body coat, longer frame than Murrah, horns curve upward and back.
Mehsana.disease_resistance: Regular persistent milk production with high fat
Mehsana.special_characteristics: Crossbreed between Murrah and Surti buffaloes; highly efficient commercial producer.

Nagori.name: Nagori
Nagori.physical_traits: White or light grey coat, long narrow face, upright horns.
Nagori.special_characteristics: Famous across India for fast trotting speed in agricultural carts.

Nagpuri.name: Nagpuri
Nagpuri.heat_tolerance: High — Adapted to dry hot Vidarbha summers
Nagpuri.physical_traits: Black coat, flat sword-like long horns extending back to shoulders.
Nagpuri.special_characteristics: Also known as Elichpuri buffalo; famous for long sword-shaped horns.

Nili_Ravi.name: Nili Ravi
Nili_Ravi.physical_traits: Black coat, walled (white) eyes, white markings on forehead, muzzle, legs and tail ('Panj Phool').
Nili_Ravi.special_characteristics: Distinct 'Panj Phool' five white marking pattern and bright white eyes.

Nimari.name: Nimari
Nimari.physical_traits: Red coat with large white splashes/patches, copper skin, long copper horns.
Nimari.special_characteristics: Originates from Gir and Khillari crossbreeding in Narmada river valley.

Pulikulam.name: Pulikulam
Pulikulam.physical_traits: Dark greyish coat, small compact active body, sharp backward curved horns.
Pulikulam.special_characteristics: Famous indigenous breed raised in migratory herds for penning manure and Jallikattu.

Rathi.name: Rathi
Rathi.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Adapted to severe desert climate
Rathi.physical_traits: Brown coat with white patches or black/white spots, medium build.
Rathi.special_characteristics: Livelihood backbone for desert pastoral communities in Western Rajasthan.

Red_Dane.name: Red Dane
Red_Dane.physical_traits: Deep red solid coat colour, strong chest and limbs, broad head.
Red_Dane.special_characteristics: High milk output with good fat content (4–4.2%).

Surti.name: Surti
Surti.physical_traits: Rusty brown/black coat, sickle-shaped horns, two white collars around brisket.
Surti.special_characteristics: Peculiar sickle horns and two white neck collars ('Tika').

Toda.name: Toda
Toda.heat_tolerance: High — Cold mountain & high rainfall adaptable
Toda.physical_traits: Fawn or dark ash coat, long dense hair, wide crescent crescent-shaped horns.
Toda.disease_resistance: Thrives in high altitude mountain mist and forest pastures
Toda.special_characteristics: Revered by the Toda tribal community of Nilgiris with unique high-fat milk.

Umblachery.name: Umblachery
Umblachery.physical_traits: Calves born red/brown changing to grey with white markings on legs and face ('Podhu').
Umblachery.disease_resistance: Resistant to foot rot and marshy infections
Umblachery.special_characteristics: Ideal for ploughing marshy rice fields in Kaveri delta.

Vechur.name: Vechur
Vechur.heat_tolerance: Extremely High — Guinness Record World's Smallest Cattle Breed
Vechur.physical_traits: Ultra-dwarf height (80-90 cm tall), light red/black coat, small forward horns.
Vechur.disease_resistance: Extremely high disease and parasite immunity
Vechur.special_characteristics: Guinness World Record smallest cattle breed; easy digestion milk with small fat globule size.
